name: AgentInvocation
description:
AgentInvocation is what a caller may ask an agent to do.

 It is the owner-settable subset of a run — the interactive
 composer's vocabulary (agent, message, harness, workspace,
 vaults, run bounds) minus what an unattended run makes structurally
 impossible. A routine or a channel that starts an agent on someone's
 behalf embeds this shape instead of re-deriving it: a routine embeds
 it whole; a channel embeds RunConfig.

fields.name: AgentRef
fields.description:
Reference to the agent to run.

 A version on the reference (a tag or a content hash) is the version
 each run starts on; none, or "latest", runs the agent's current version
 when the run starts.

fields.name: Harness
fields.description:
Harness for the run's session. Unspecified: native (Stigmer) when
 run_config names a model (the harness the model was checked against at
 save), else the agent's own harness (AgentSpec.harness), else the
 embedding surface's platform default.

fields.name: Vaults
fields.description:
Vaults whose logins and secrets the runs this invocation creates use, in
 order: the first vault holding a match wins. At most 20.

 A routine's runs use these vaults and no others. The routine's owner
 may attach their own My vault; nobody else's.

fields.name: RunConfig
fields.description:
Per-invocation model choice and run bounds. Unset fields fall to the
 agent's defaults, then to the lane's operator profile (RunConfig has the
 rule).

fields.name: EnvironmentRef
fields.description:
The Environment the conversations this invocation starts run in: the
 packages their sandboxes get and the websites they may reach. Unset:
 the agent's default, else the organization's.

fields.name: Resources
fields.description:
What each run's conversation holds: Files and git repositories (a
 routine's runs have no machine of the person's to read a folder from).
 Each run's conversation gets its own copy of each File, made when the
 run starts, so every nightly run finds the same q3-ledger.xlsx.
